categories.A: Original or independently corroborated news graphics
categories.B: Genuine photographs with demonstrably false or misleading context

fixture_requirements.A: A legally reusable news graphic plus publisher/origin record and at least one independent authoritative corroboration of its claim and publication date.
fixture_requirements.B: A licensed genuine photograph with documented original event/date/location and a preserved false caption or repost, supported by an authoritative debunk or source comparison.
fixture_requirements.C: A licensed image with generator provenance (prompt/run record or trustworthy benchmark annotation), preferably including generator family and post-processing history.
fixture_requirements.D: A licensed original-and-edited pair with an edit mask or operation log for compositing/object removal; preserve export history and exact hashes.

ground_truth.claim: Official C2PA public test asset with a valid simple claim; this establishes the expected C2PA validation behavior, not whether the depicted pixels are news, AI-generated, or manipulated.

expected.media_authenticity: Valid C2PA and asset integrity should be reported; no content-class label is justified.
expected.claim_context: No factual news-context conclusion is expected.
